question.text: Which of the following is NOT among the 16 eligible activities for SE recognition listed under SEBI (ICDR) Reg 292B(1)?

answer.text: Facilitating trading in listed equity derivatives on recognised stock exchanges
Eradicating hunger, poverty, malnutrition and inequality
Promoting gender equality, empowerment of women, LGBTQIA+ communities

explanation.text: The Logic: Reg 292B(1) lists 16 eligible activity areas — all aligned to SDGs: hunger/poverty, education, gender, healthcare, environment, rural development, sports, arts/heritage, armed forces welfare, disaster response, technology incubation for social impact, housing, financial inclusion, water/sanitation, slum development, sustainable environment. Trading in equity derivatives is a capital-markets activity, NOT a social-impact activity. The Trap: All three other options map directly to named areas among the 16. Derivatives trading is an ICDR equity / FO-segment activity but NOT a social-impact eligible activity. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B/C/D/E covers derivatives / AIF; XXIII excludes such market-facing activities from SE eligibility. The list is short-form memorisable — print it on your engagement cover. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Pin the full 16-activity list to your audit room wall. When scoping a new SE, circle the activities the SE claims and verify each against its project documents — mismatches (or 'stretched' claims) are the most common eligibility failure.
